text.p: Results of International Cricket Council (ICC) Trophy matches on Wednesday:
Scores: Canada 264-8 in 50 overs; Namibia 204 all out in 43.2 overs
Scores: Israel 88 all out in 31.5 overs; Ireland 89-0 in 17.2 overs
Scotland beat Hong Kong by 87 runs
Scores: Scotland 221-6 in 50 overs; Hong Kong 134 all out in 40.4 overs
Papua New Guinea beat Italy by 101 runs
Scores: Papua New Guinea 219-4 in 50 overs; Italy 118 all out in 48 overs
Fiji beat East and Central Africa by 35 runs
Scores: Fiji 111 all out in 40.3 overs; East and Central Africa 76 all out in 44 overs
Denmark beat United Arab Emirates by one run
Scores: Denmark 148-9 in 50 overs; United Arab Emirates 147 all out in 46.2 overs.
Thursday's matches: Bangladesh v Denmark, Kenya v Gibraltar, Singapore v Israel, United Arab Emirates v Malaysia, United States v Ireland, West Africa v Argentina.
